documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sri Lotus reported pre-sales of INR470 crores in Q2 FY27 and INR879 crores in H1 FY27, backed by strong revenue growth and high margins. Management remains confident in achieving its FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26. The company added three new projects during the quarter, bringing its total ongoing and upcoming pipeline to 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores. Furthermore, management plans to launch four projects in H2 FY27 and maintains a net cash position of INR494 crores. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong first half for FY27 with pre-sales growing 176% YoY to INR 879 Crs and reiterating its full-year guidance of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident in delivering the FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: EBITDA and PAT margins for FY27 are expected to be 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR 1,800 to 2,000 crores and revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores in the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is largely driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial properties are witnessing good momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: So, yes, there is a good moment for commercial properties, and we have very balanced portfolio of commercial.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces in the Gift City area project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, showing that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11% led by upgraders.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates. Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: Pricing achieved in the company's micro-market is normally 10% to 15% higher than other developers.
demand_outlook.quote: So, regarding the pricing related to other developers, so normally in our micro-market we are getting 10% to 15% higher than the other developers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter: Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City project comprises a 5.5-acre land parcel expected to yield 1.3 million to 1.5 million square feet of mixed-use space.
capex_expansion.quote: Sure. It's a 5.5-acre land parcel, which is sitting right on the river Sabarmati. It's in GIFT area.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus, Lotus Empressa, and Lotus Stellar, adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: Four launches are planned for the second half, including Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with combined estimated GDV of approximately INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR 1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR 1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR 3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: For H1 FY27, EBITDA stood at INR155 crores with a margin of 38.80%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin is stated to be approximately 25%-30% on a consistent basis.
margins_costs.quote:
PAT Margin (%)
~ 25%-30%
on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR 46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR 48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Average selling price stood at INR 86,000 per square foot.
margins_costs.quote: Our average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot, underscoring the strength of our product across the micro-markets we operate in.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 were recorded at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Delighted to share that we recorded pre-sales for the quarter at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for H1 FY27 stood at INR879 crores, up 176% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR879 crores, up 176% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

orders_capacity.claim: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales stood at INR 409 crores, up 567% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of the portfolio.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, our estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of its IPO with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds earmarked for subsidiaries, INR305 crores had been deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026. We remain on track with our planned utilization schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: Fresh issue proceeds from the IPO of INR 792 Crs are used for part-funding development and construction cost of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: Collections stood at INR 150 crores, up 115% year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: Collections stood at INR150 crores, up by 115% year-on-year.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, total cash balance was approximately INR 776 crores against debt of INR 153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR 623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR 550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR 271 crores has been deployed as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
